articles.summary: Oshkosh Corporation (NYSE: OSK), a global industrial technology company that develops purpose-built vehicles, equipment and services, today announced that two of its advanced technologies have been named CES Innovation Awards® 2027 Honorees by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®.
articles.title: Oshkosh Corporation Earns Two CES Innovation Awards® 2027 Honoree Distinctions for Advancements in Autonomy and Connected Technologies
